question: Find the average age of students who do not have any pet .
gold_sql: select avg(age) from student where stuid not in (select stuid from has_pet)
sql:
SELECT AVG(s.Age) AS average_age
FROM Student AS s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Has_Pet AS hp
    WHERE hp.StuID = s.StuID
);

question: List all singer names in concerts in year 2014.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM singer_in_concert AS T1 JOIN singer AS T2 ON T1.singer_id  =  T2.singer_id JOIN concert AS T3 ON T1.concert_id  =  T3.concert_id WHERE T3.year  =  2014
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.Name
FROM singer AS s
JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID
JOIN concert AS c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
WHERE c.Year = '2014';
raw_text:
{"sql":"SELECT DISTINCT s.Name
FROM singer AS s
JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID
JOIN concert AS c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
WHERE c.Year = '2014';"}

question: How many owners temporarily do not have any dogs?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Owners WHERE owner_id NOT IN ( SELECT owner_id FROM Dogs )
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS owner_count
FROM Owners AS o
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Dogs AS d
    WHERE d.owner_id = o.owner_id
);

question: Find the owner id and zip code of the owner who spent the most money in total for his or her dogs.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.owner_id ,  T1.zip_code FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id JOIN Treatments AS T3 ON T2.dog_id  =  T3.dog_id GROUP BY T1.owner_id ORDER BY sum(T3.cost_of_treatment) DESC LIMIT 1
sql:
SELECT o.owner_id, o.zip_code
FROM Owners AS o
JOIN Dogs AS d ON d.owner_id = o.owner_id
JOIN Treatments AS t ON t.dog_id = d.dog_id
GROUP BY o.owner_id, o.zip_code
ORDER BY SUM(t.cost_of_treatment) DESC
LIMIT 1;

{"sql":"SELECT o.owner_id, o.zip_code
FROM Owners AS o
JOIN Dogs AS d ON d.owner_id = o.owner_id
JOIN Treatments AS t ON t.dog_id = d.dog_id
GROUP BY o.owner_id, o.zip_code
ORDER BY SUM(t.cost_of_treatment) DESC
LIMIT 1;"}
